title: crystalliser operation
description: Crystalliser, in one of three model depths selected by the unit's `model` slot: `equilibrium` (the supersaturation is relieved completely — no kinetics, no vessel size), `msmpr` (a mixed-suspension mixed-product-removal population balance with mean sizes) and the binned population balance that resolves the full size distribution. The deeper models need `volume`; the equilibrium model does not read it. The heat of crystallisation is NOT entered here for a curated solute — it is derived from the substance's own record (a molecular solute's `solubility { dHcryst }`, an electrolyte's ion-derived dissolution enthalpy), and the same shared resolver serves the steady and batch paths so they can never diverge.

operatingTemperature.title: Operating temperature
operatingTemperature.description: Vessel temperature. With the solubility curve it fixes the supersaturation and therefore the yield.

volume.title: Working suspension volume
volume.description: Required by the `msmpr` and population-balance models (it sets the residence time); not read by the `equilibrium` model.

solute.title: Crystallising solute
solute.description: Which component crystallises, when the mixture holds more than one candidate. Naming it removes the ambiguity rather than letting the engine pick.

solidsRecovery.title: Solids recovery
solidsRecovery.description: Fraction of the formed crystals that leaves in the cake; the remainder returns with the mother liquor. Defaults to 1.0 (a perfect separation).

cakeMoisture.title: Cake moisture
cakeMoisture.description: Mass fraction of mother liquor retained in the cake; defaults to 0.10. It carries dissolved solute with it, so it changes the recovered purity, not only the wetness.

bins.title: Size-distribution bins
bins.description: Population-balance model only: number of size classes; defaults to 64.

Lmax.title: Largest resolved size
Lmax.description: Population-balance model only: upper edge of the size grid; defaults to 1e-3 m. A distribution that piles up against it is a sign the grid is too short.

dHcryst.title: Heat of crystallisation override
dHcryst.description: Electrolyte path only: an explicit, announced override of the ion-derived duty, for a salt whose dissolution enthalpy is not curated. A molecular solute takes its value from its own `solubility { dHcryst }` record and this key does not apply.
